summary: TypeScript tool-calling example fails to compile due to tool result message type mismatch (tool result shape)
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports the TypeScript docs example for tool calling fails to compile in a fresh project. The example appears to assume an older tool result/message shape than what the current SDK types accept.

Impact:
- Copy/paste failure in docs and README examples
- Customer blocked from implementing tool-result loop in TypeScript without using `any`

Customer report (verbatim-ish):
"When I try the tool calling snippet from the docs, TypeScript errors on the tool result message. It says the tool result shape doesn’t match the expected `ChatMessage` union. If I cast it to `any` it runs, but we’d like proper typing."

Environment:
- Node: 20.x
- TypeScript: 5.3.x
- redwood SDK: `redwood@0.18.0` (customer-provided)
- Region: us-east
- Models tried: `rw-gpt-4o-mini`, `rw-llama-3.1-70b-instruct`

Steps to reproduce:
1) Create new TS project (`npm init -y`, `npm i typescript ts-node`)
2) Install SDK (`npm i redwood`)
3) Copy tool calling example from docs (Tool calling guide -> "Return tool results")
4) `npx ts-node index.ts`

Observed:
- TypeScript compile error when constructing tool result message

Example error (customer screenshot transcription):
- TS2322: Type '{ role: "tool"; tool_call_id: string; content: string; }' is not assignable to type 'ChatMessage'.
- Property 'type' is missing in type '{ role: "tool"; ... }' but required in type 'ToolResultMessage'.

Expected:
- Example compiles and runs without casts.

Initial hypothesis:
Docs show an OpenAI-style `{ role: "tool", tool_call_id, content }` message shape, but the Redwood TS SDK types in the current release use a `type: "tool_result"` message variant (and/or different property naming).

2025-02-11 10:26 Priya Shah (Support): Able to repro internally with current published docs snippet + redwood@0.18.0. The docs show `role: "tool"` but SDK expects discriminated union with `type: "tool_result"`. Loop compiles if we add `type: "tool_result"` and rename fields to match `tool_call_id`/`toolCallId` depending on import. Routing to Dana Lo (TS SDK) + Elliot/Wei (Docs) for alignment.

2025-02-11 10:48 Dana Lo (TS SDK): Confirmed mismatch. SDK types were tightened recently; docs snippet is still using OpenAI-compat message shape. We should (1) update docs to canonical shape and (2) consider loosening acceptance in the SDK helper layer or provide a helper constructor in examples. Will patch in next point release and update examples.

2025-02-11 11:12 Wei Chen (Docs): Acknowledged. We have an in-flight tool calling docs refresh; will incorporate the canonical message union and add a small note: 'tool result messages differ from OpenAI role=tool shape'.

`{ type: "tool_result", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify(result) } as const` (exact field names depend on their SDK import).

2025-02-13 14:21 Dana Lo (TS SDK): PR merged: redwood-sdk-typescript/pr-1932. Includes updated example and a small compatibility type so users can pass OpenAI-style tool messages without type gymnastics in most cases.

2025-02-14 10:08 Wei Chen (Docs): Docs PR merged: redwood-docs/pr-519. Tool calling page updated to match TS/Python/Go canonical pattern. Added 'Known pitfalls' bullet: OpenAI role=tool vs Redwood tool_result discriminant.
2025-02-17 09:30 Connor O'Brien (Releases): TS SDK version cut: redwood@0.18.1 includes PR-1932 changes. Changelog mentions tool calling type mismatch fix + updated examples.
2025-02-17 10:05 Priya Shah (Support): Confirmed with customer: updating to redwood@0.18.1 resolves compile error; docs link now matches. Moving ticket to Resolved.
resolution:
Resolved via TS SDK typing + examples update and docs correction.

Fix:
- Released `redwood@0.18.1` with updated tool-calling types and aligned example snippet (GitHub: redwood-sdk-typescript/pr-1932-update-tool-calling-types-and-examples)
- Updated tool calling docs to show the canonical tool result message shape and added a 'Known pitfalls' callout (GitHub: redwood-docs/pr-519-refresh-tool-calling-docs-and-known-pitfalls)

Customer workaround (while waiting for release):
- Use the discriminated union form for tool result messages (include `type: "tool_result"`) or temporarily cast the message to `any`.

Customer confirmation:
- NorthStarApps confirmed upgrade to 0.18.1 resolves TypeScript compile errors and example runs end-to-end.
internal_notes:
Root cause: docs snippet drifted to an OpenAI-compat shape (`role: "tool"`) while the TS SDK exposed a stricter discriminated union (`type: "tool_result"`). Copy/paste failed because types did not accept the docs shape.

Prevention:
- Ensure docs snippets are generated/checked against SDK fixtures where possible (see monorepo PR: snippet sync check).
- Keep tool calling parity guidelines as source of truth for example payload shapes.

Owner follow-ups:
- Dana Lo: confirm no other docs pages still reference `role: "tool"` in TypeScript tabs.
- Wei Chen: add a short compatibility note linking to OpenAI-compat differences thread for users migrating.
